request_user:
Fact: data_provenance
What to find: Provenance categories of training data (web crawl, licensed/third-party private, user data, public datasets, synthetic, other).
Card sections that often contain it: Training Data, Data Sources

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Only partial provenance is given. The SFT multimodal reasoning data is model-generated (synthetic): InternVL3-78B described images and DeepSeek-R1 sampled reasoning rollouts. SFT also reuses instruction-following data from InternVL3. Pre-training uses "large-scale text and multimodal corpora" with no sources given. The metadata lists the datasets OpenGVLab/MMPR-v1.2 and OpenGVLab/MMPR-Tiny. The card gives no web-crawl, licensed, or user-data categories.
quotes: To construct such data, we first use InternVL3-78B to describe the image and then input the description into DeepSeek-R1 to sample rollouts with detailed reasoning processes.
(1) Instruction-following data from InternVL3, which are reused to preserve broad coverage of vision–language tasks.
During the pre-training stage, we update all model parameters jointly using the combination of large-scale text and multimodal corpora.
